title: Proverbs Chapter 9 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Proverbs chapter 9 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Proverbs Chapter 9 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Proverbs Chapter 9.

questions.question: What has Wisdom built according to Proverbs 9?
questions.explanation: Wisdom hath builded her house, as stated in Proverbs 9:1.

questions.question: How many pillars has Wisdom hewn out?
questions.explanation: She hath hewn out her seven pillars, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:1.

questions.question: What has Wisdom mingled according to Proverbs 9?
questions.explanation: She hath mingled her wine, as stated in Proverbs 9:2.

questions.question: What does Wisdom invite simple people to do?
questions.explanation: She saith to him, Come, eat of my bread, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:5.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9, what should one forsake to live?
questions.explanation: Forsake the foolish, and live; as stated in Proverbs 9:6.

questions.question: True or False: Wisdom has sent forth her maidens.
questions.explanation: She hath sent forth her maidens, as stated in Proverbs 9:3.

questions.question: True or False: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom.
questions.explanation: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:10.

questions.question: What should a wise man do when given instruction?
questions.explanation: Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser, as stated in Proverbs 9:9.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9, who should not be reproved?
questions.explanation: He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:7.

questions.question: In Proverbs 9, what does the foolish woman do?
questions.explanation: For she sitteth at the door of her house, to call passengers, as stated in Proverbs 9:14-15.

questions.question: True or False: Stolen waters are sweet according to Proverbs 9.
questions.explanation: Stolen waters are sweet, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:17.

questions.question: True or False: The wise will hate correction.
questions.explanation: Rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee, which indicates that the wise do not hate correction, as stated in Proverbs 9:8.

questions.question: What does Wisdom offer to those who are simple?
questions.explanation: Come, eat of my bread, as stated in Proverbs 9:5.

questions.question: In Proverbs 9, who alone will bear the consequences of scorn?
questions.explanation: If thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:12.

questions.question: In Proverbs 9, what is the consequence of following the foolish?
questions.explanation: But he knoweth not that the dead are there; indicating dire consequences, as mentioned in Proverbs 9:18.

medium.title: Proverbs Chapter 9 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Proverbs Chapter 9 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What is promised to those who fear the Lord, according to Proverbs 9?
options: They will be multiplied in days
questions.correctAnswer: They will be multiplied in days
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:11 states that 'For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased,' indicating that fearing the Lord leads to longer life.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:9, what happens when you give instruction to a wise man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:9 says, 'Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser,' showing that wisdom begets more wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:10 say is the beginning of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10 states, 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom,' emphasizing the foundational role of reverence for God in gaining wisdom.

questions.question: If someone scorns instruction, what does Proverbs 9:12 say will happen to them?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:12 states, 'but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it,' indicating that rejecting wisdom leads to personal consequences.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:8, what should you do instead of reproving a scorner?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:8 advises, 'Reprove not a scorner, lest he hate thee: rebuke a wise man, and he will love thee,' suggesting that wise individuals appreciate correction.

questions.question: In Proverbs 9:6, what does wisdom encourage people to forsake?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:6 states, 'Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding,' highlighting the importance of avoiding foolishness for a better life.

questions.question: What type of woman is described in Proverbs 9:13?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:13 states, 'A foolish woman is clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing,' illustrating the characteristics of foolishness.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:7 say about reproving a scorner?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:7 indicates that 'He that reproveth a scorner getteth to himself shame,' warning against rebuking those who scorn wisdom.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 9:5, wisdom invites the simple to eat her bread and drink her wine.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:5 states, 'Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled,' showing that wisdom offers nourishment to those seeking understanding.

questions.question: True or False: Proverbs 9:16 invites the wise to turn in hither.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:16 states, 'Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither,' indicating that it is the simple who are invited, not the wise.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:17 imply about stolen waters?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:17 states, 'Stolen waters are sweet,' suggesting that wrong choices may seem appealing but have underlying consequences.

questions.question: True or False: According to Proverbs 9:18, the guests of the foolish woman are in the depths of hell.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:18 states, 'But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell,' warning against the dangers of foolishness.

hard.title: Proverbs Chapter 9 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Proverbs Chapter 9.

questions.question: What does Wisdom do in Proverbs 9:1?
questions.explanation: Wisdom is personified as having built her house, indicating preparation and stability. This is stated in Proverbs 9:1.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:10, what is the beginning of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10 explicitly states that 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom,' emphasizing the foundational aspect of reverence for God in acquiring wisdom.

questions.question: In Proverbs 9:13, how is a foolish woman described?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:13 describes the foolish woman as clamorous and simple, highlighting her lack of understanding.

questions.question: What invitation does Wisdom offer in Proverbs 9:5?
questions.explanation: In Proverbs 9:5, Wisdom invites those who seek understanding to partake of her bread and wine, symbolizing nourishment and enlightenment.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:9, what happens when you give instruction to a wise man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:9 states that giving instruction to a wise man results in him becoming yet wiser, indicating the value of learning.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:18 warn about the foolish woman's guests?
options: They are in the depths of hell
questions.correctAnswer: They are in the depths of hell
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:18 cautions that the guests of the foolish woman do not realize they are in the depths of hell, highlighting the dangers of following folly.

questions.question: True or False: The wise man will love a rebuke according to Proverbs 9:8.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:8 states that rebuking a wise man will result in him loving the rebuker, indicating a wise person's openness to correction.

questions.question: What literary device is prominently used in Proverbs 9:10-12?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10-12 utilizes parallelism, where the second line reflects or contrasts with the first, enhancing the meaning through repetition.

questions.question: What does the phrase 'stolen waters are sweet' in Proverbs 9:17 represent?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:17 suggests that 'stolen waters are sweet,' symbolizing the allure and deceptive pleasure of sinful choices.

questions.question: True or False: A wise person bears their scorn according to Proverbs 9:12.
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:12 indicates that if one scorns wisdom, they will bear the consequences alone, not implying they bear scorn but face it themselves.

questions.question: Which other biblical passage connects with the theme of wisdom as found in Proverbs 9:10?
questions.explanation: James 1:5 encourages believers to ask God for wisdom, connecting with Proverbs 9:10 where the fear of the LORD is foundational for wisdom.

questions.question: Proverbs 9:14 describes the foolish woman sitting where?
options: On a seat in high places
questions.correctAnswer: On a seat in high places
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:14 notes that the foolish woman sits at the door of her house in high places, symbolizing her attempt to attract attention.

questions.question: Which theme is echoed in Matthew 7:24-27 that relates to Proverbs 9:1?
questions.explanation: Matthew 7:24-27 discusses building one's house on a rock, which parallels Proverbs 9:1's imagery of Wisdom building her house with stability.

theological.title: Proverbs Chapter 9 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Proverbs Chapter 9 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What is the primary activity associated with Wisdom in Proverbs 9:1?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:1 states, 'Wisdom hath builded her house, she hath hewn out her seven pillars,' indicating that the building of her house is a key activity associated with Wisdom.

questions.question: What does Wisdom provide to those who turn to her according to Proverbs 9:5?
questions.explanation: In Proverbs 9:5, Wisdom invites those who seek understanding to 'Come, eat of my bread, and drink of the wine which I have mingled,' indicating she provides sustenance and nourishment.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:10, what is the beginning of wisdom?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10 states, 'The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom,' highlighting the essential relationship between reverence for God and the acquisition of wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:12 teach about the consequences of being wise or a scorner?
options: You will be wise for others
You will bear your own consequences
You will find favor with kings
questions.correctAnswer: You will bear your own consequences
questions.explanation: This verse, 'If thou be wise, thou shalt be wise for thyself: but if thou scornest, thou alone shalt bear it,' teaches that the outcomes of wisdom and scorn are personal and individual.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:11 imply about the benefits of Wisdom?
options: It multiplies days and years of life
questions.correctAnswer: It multiplies days and years of life
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:11 states, 'For by me thy days shall be multiplied, and the years of thy life shall be increased,' emphasizing the life-giving benefits of Wisdom.

questions.question: What character trait is attributed to a foolish woman in Proverbs 9:13?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:13 describes a foolish woman as 'clamorous: she is simple, and knoweth nothing,' indicating her loudness and lack of understanding.

questions.question: According to Proverbs 9:6, what should one do to find life?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:6 instructs, 'Forsake the foolish, and live; and go in the way of understanding,' indicating that abandoning foolishness is essential for life.

questions.question: What is the invitation given to the simple in Proverbs 9:16?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:16 states, 'Whoso is simple, let him turn in hither: and as for him that wanteth understanding, she saith to him,' inviting the simple to seek Wisdom.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:9 suggest about teaching a wise man?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:9 teaches, 'Give instruction to a wise man, and he will be yet wiser,' indicating that wise individuals value and grow from instruction.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:18 reveal about the consequences of following a foolish woman?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:18 warns, 'But he knoweth not that the dead are there; and that her guests are in the depths of hell,' indicating the grave consequences of folly.

questions.question: How does Proverbs 9:4-5 combine the invitation of Wisdom with its sustenance?
questions.explanation: The combined teaching of Proverbs 9:4-5 emphasizes Wisdom's invitation to the simple to come and partake of the sustenance she offers, represented by bread and wine.

questions.question: What combined teaching do Proverbs 9:7-8 convey about responding to correction?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:7-8 teaches that while reproving a scorner can lead to shame, rebuking a wise man leads to love, emphasizing the value of correction for the wise.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that wisdom leads only to personal gain. What does Proverbs 9:12 teach?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:12 shows that being wise benefits oneself, but scorners will bear the consequences of their folly, countering the idea that wisdom is purely self-serving.

questions.question: What attribute of God is illustrated in Proverbs 9:10 regarding the fear of the Lord?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:10 ('The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom') reveals that God's wisdom is foundational to understanding and reverence.

questions.question: What does Proverbs 9:2 indicate about the preparation of Wisdom's table?
options: It is for the wise only
questions.explanation: Proverbs 9:2 mentions that Wisdom has killed her beasts and furnished her table, indicating that it is abundant and inviting for those who seek it.
